title: Can Fuel Oil Be Turned into Silver?
section_path: Can Fuel Oil Be Turned into Silver?
section_path_text: Can Fuel Oil Be Turned into Silver?
summary: Can Fuel Oil Be Turned into Silver? The fuel oil market in 2004 has been characterized by increased demand, volatile prices, changing regulations and new restrictions on tanker transportation. In this dynamic environment, the timing for the Silver Anniversary of the international Fuel Oil/Energy Buyers' Conference would seem to be quite appropriate.

children.summary: SHORT- AND MEDIUM- TERM OUTLOOK FOR OIL PRICES John Brunton , Manager, Trading Innovation & Application Cargill, Geneva Office will provide insight into the new OPEC long-term outlook and the importance of coal prices to residual oil.

children.title: VOPAK PRESENTATION
children.summary: Hari Dattatreya, Divisional Director, sales & Marketing, Vopak, Netherlands will discuss Vopak's historical evolution, their terminal activity, worldwide fuel oil storage activity including shipping logistics and blending capability.
